meaning:
Jokmeam = "gathered by the people"
a city of refuge in Ephraim given to the Kohathite Levites
Another name of yoq.ne.am (יׇקְנְעָם "Jokneam" H3362)

elsewhere.note: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as…
Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,
